name: Colloidal / Polyol Nanoparticle Synthesis with Deposition
description: Metal nanoparticles are formed first in solution, by polyol or borohydride reduction with a capping agent, then deposited on the support and freed of the capping agent by washing and a mild thermal treatment. Gives narrow size distributions that impregnation cannot.

step_quantities.note: Precursor, reductant and capping agent make-up
Colloid formation and deposition onto the support

source: Munnik, de Jongh and de Jong, Recent developments in the synthesis of supported catalysts, Chem. Rev. 115, 6687 (2015); Yang and Kuwahara, PdAg alloy nanoparticles in N-doped carbon, Appl. Catal. B 283, 119628 (2021)
route_note: Solvent and capping-agent consumption per kilogram of catalyst is far above impregnation; those enter as materials, not steps.
